categories.main_business_segments: Shanghai United Imaging Healthcare Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the development, production, and sales of high-end medical imaging diagnostic equipment and radiation therapy devices. Its product portfolio includes Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI), Computed Tomography (CT), X-ray imaging systems (XR), Molecular Imaging (MI) systems such as PET/CT and PET/MR, Radiation Therapy (RT) equipment including linear accelerators, and life science instruments. The company also provides maintenance services and software development related to medical imaging.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes core technologies such as superconducting magnets, high-performance gradient coils, digital power amplifiers, X-ray tubes, high-voltage generators, and advanced imaging algorithms including AI-driven reconstruction and noise reduction. It has developed proprietary technologies in photon-counting spectral CT, ultra-high field MRI (up to 5.0T), integrated CT-guided radiotherapy accelerators, and digital PET detectors based on silicon photomultipliers. Production methods include intelligent manufacturing with digitalized and modular production lines across multiple global sites, ensuring vertical integration from core components to complete systems.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include hospitals, medical research institutions, and universities, spanning from top-tier medical centers to grassroots healthcare facilities. The company serves clinical and research applications in neurology, oncology, cardiovascular, and women's health, among others. Its markets cover domestic China extensively and international regions including North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific, Middle East, Africa, and Latin America, with a focus on high-end medical institutions and emerging markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with a strong presence in China and expanding footprints in over 85 countries and regions worldwide. It has established regional headquarters and R&D centers in the United States, Malaysia, the Netherlands, the United Arab Emirates, and other countries. Its products are installed in leading hospitals across North America, Europe, Asia, and emerging markets such as India, Brazil, and South Africa.
categories.supply_chain_position: United Imaging Healthcare operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the medical equipment supply chain. It controls the full value chain from core component development and manufacturing (e.g., magnets, detectors, power amplifiers) to system integration, final product assembly, and after-sales service. The company also fosters a domestic supply ecosystem with nearly a thousand local suppliers, enhancing supply chain resilience and localization.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on technological innovation and integration of AI with high-end medical equipment. It pursues a vertical innovation system covering complete machines, core components, and underlying materials. R&D priorities include ultra-high field MRI, photon-counting CT, AI-enabled imaging and diagnostics, integrated radiotherapy systems, and digital molecular imaging. It emphasizes global collaboration with top medical and research institutions and invests heavily in expanding its R&D workforce and patent portfolio.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sales of medical imaging and radiotherapy equipment, supplemented by maintenance and after-sales services. The company also earns income from software products and solutions related to medical imaging and diagnostics. Sales channels include direct sales and distributor networks, with a growing proportion of revenue from overseas markets.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: United Imaging Healthcare is positioned as a leading domestic and global competitor in high-end medical imaging and radiotherapy equipment. It competes with international giants such as GE Healthcare, Siemens Healthineers, and Philips Healthcare. The company holds top market shares in China for CT, MRI, PET/CT, and diagnostic X-ray systems and is rapidly expanding its presence in international markets, especially in high-end and emerging segments.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 10.3 billion, representing a 9.73% decline year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 1.26 billion, down 36.08%. Despite short-term profit pressure due to market and policy factors, the company’s total assets grew 10.65% to RMB 28 billion, and equity increased 5.5% to RMB 19.9 billion. R&D investment increased to 21.95% of revenue, reflecting a strong growth trajectory focused on innovation and international expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: United Imaging Healthcare differentiates itself through comprehensive product coverage across imaging and therapy, cutting-edge proprietary technologies, and deep integration of AI throughout the diagnostic and treatment workflow. Its products offer high performance, precision, and energy efficiency, with unique features such as the world’s only 5.0T whole-body MRI with global certifications, photon-counting CT, and integrated CT-guided radiotherapy systems. The company emphasizes clinical value, user experience, and sustainability, providing tailored solutions for diverse healthcare settings and fostering collaborative innovation ecosystems.
